articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout
articles.description: China’s five-year digital development plan calls for wider blockchain use in trade and manufacturing alongside stronger technical standards.

articles.title: New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
articles.description: The request follows an August 2025 default judgment, with the AG also announcing nearly $6 million in settlements with four promoters.

articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates after 3% loss as AI fears stoke fresh stock-market weakness
articles.description: Bitcoin price volatility cooled as stock markets battled another day of resurgent AI fears during Friday’s Asia trading session.

articles.title: Was crypto self-custody ever designed for beginners?
articles.description: Recent hardware wallet security incidents have renewed debate over whether self-custody is suitable for beginners, as multisig and seedless designs carry their own risks.

articles.title: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
articles.description: The attacker moved $744,000 in ETH and BNB to Tornado Cash after exploiting Cysic’s bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain.

articles.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
articles.description: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.

articles.title: HSBC launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin for retail payments
articles.description: HSBC is rolling out RedCoin wallets to PayMe users, with plans to support tokenized investment subscriptions and expand into institutional uses.

articles.title: Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
articles.description: BLOOM seeks to cut costs by helping financial institutions coordinate cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $635M as October slides back into the red
articles.description: Thursday’s withdrawals ended a three-day inflow streak and left US spot Bitcoin ETFs with $175 million in net outflows for October.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
articles.description: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.description: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: Switzerland’s first retail spot Bitcoin ETF targets November launch
articles.description: BIT Asset Management’s Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.

articles.title: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
articles.description: Hegseth warned that prediction market wagers could expose military operations to adversaries.

articles.title: New DeepSeek ban in US, Swiss-Asia crypto ties deepen: Asia Express
articles.description: DeepSeek banned from US federal civilian agencies over spying fears. Singapore firm behind Europe’s only spot Bitcoin ETF, as Switzerland partners with Vietnam on crypto tech.

articles.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
articles.description: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.

articles.title: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues
articles.description: The new service aims to bring onchain trading data into institutional financial systems as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.

articles.title: Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy
articles.description: While crypto-aligned PACs have stepped up spending in Ohio, a committee launched by the co-founders of crypto exchange Gemini made one of its first forays into the Lone Star State.

articles.title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
articles.description: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.description: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
articles.description: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.

articles.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
articles.description: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

articles.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
articles.description: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.

articles.title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
articles.description: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.

articles.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

articles.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
articles.description: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
articles.description: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

articles.title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
articles.description: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.

articles.title: CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
articles.description: CoinDCX said it covered losses caused by a failed transfer process involving compromised wallets and credited all affected user accounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
articles.description: Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.
